Browser-rendered photographic reproduction of the white-border [[Asteroids Do Not Concern Me (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]]. The source page credits the photograph to Duncan Jenkins. This PNG is a technical crop of an actual browser screenshot of that photograph; it is not a native JPEG download, publisher scan or facsimile.

== Source ==
* Browser-rendered physical white-border photograph: [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67321 collector catalogue], photograph credited to Duncan Jenkins (photograph GA08203.JPG).

== Preparation ==
The complete 1920 x 993-pixel source screenshot is retained unchanged and separately from its complete rendered page DOM. Rectangle (426, 281) to (946, 985) was extracted with right and bottom coordinates exclusive, converted to RGB and resized using Lanczos to 350 x 474 pixels. No printed words, art, border or icons were redrawn, recolored or reconstructed. No native JPEG bytes or image HTTP200 response are claimed. The catalogue year is not first-publication evidence.

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122081056/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/7/78/Dagobah-Revised-L-asteroidsdonotconcernme-physical-browser-photo.png Internet Archive].
